fields.name: override type#this attachment will override the attachment on the object that shares this
autoaim angle:percent#the maximum angle that autoaim works at full strength
prioritization angle:percent#angle used to select model targets based on priority
autoaim range:percent#autoaim only has an effect along this distance
autoaim falloff range:percent#at what point the autoaim starts falling off.  Fully falls off at autoaim range.
autoaim near falloff range:percent#at what point the autoaim reaches full power
magnetism angle:percent#at what point the autoaim reaches full power
magnetism range:percent#magnetism only has an effect along this distance
magnetism falloff range:percent#at what point magnetism starts falling off.  Fully falls off at magnetism range.
magnetism near falloff range:percent#at what point magnetism reaches full power
deviation angle:percent#the maximum angle that a projectile is allowed to deviate from the gun barrel due to autoaim OR network lead vector reconstruction
view kick return to center modifier:percent
reload while empty playback speed modifier:percent
overheated heat loss per second modifier:percent
display name#friendly name for the item
help text#verbose usage info for use during gameplay
icon string id#legacy, from when we embedded the sprites into the font to get streaming behaviour
sprite index#frame inside the item's image strip which shows this item
alt sprite#secondary bitmap file representing this item. for detail images, overlays etc.
rounds per second#the number of firing effects created per second.  0 defaults to 60
rate of fire acceleration#function value sets the current rate of fire when the barrel is firing
acceleration time:seconds#the continuous firing time it takes for the weapon to achieve its final rounds per second
rate of fire deceleration#function value sets the current rate of fire when the barrel is not firing
deceleration time:seconds#the continuous idle time it takes for the weapon to return from its final rounds per second to its initial
barrel spin scale#scale the barrel spin speed by this amount
blurred rate of fire#a percentage between 0 and 1 which controls how soon in its firing animation the weapon blurs
shots per fire#allows designer caps to the shots you can fire from one firing action
fire recovery time:seconds#how long after a set of shots it takes before the barrel can fire again
soft recovery fraction#how much of the recovery allows shots to be queued
melee  fire recovery time:seconds#how long after a set of shots it takes before the weapon can melee
melee soft recovery fraction#how much of the melee recovery allows melee to be queued
runtime rate of fire acceleration rate!
runtime rate of fire deceleration rate!
shot count lower bound#the minimum number of times this firing effect will be used, once it has been chosen
shot count upper bound#the maximum number of times this firing effect will be used, once it has been chosen
firing effect^#this effect is used when the weapon is loaded and fired normally
critical effect^#this effect is used when the weapon is loaded and will do critical damage
misfire effect#this effect is used when the weapon is loaded but fired while overheated
empty effect#this effect is used when the weapon is not loaded
optional secondary firing effect#this effect is for later shots of a burst if set
firing damage#this effect is used when the weapon is loaded and fired normally
critical damage^#this effect is used when the weapon is loaded and will do critical damage
misfire damage#this effect is used when the weapon is loaded but fired while overheated
empty damage#this effect is used when the weapon is not loaded
optional secondary firing damage#this effect is for later shots of a burst if set
firing rider damage#this effect is used when the weapon is loaded and fired normally
critical rider damage^#this effect is used when the weapon is loaded and will do critical damage
misfire rider damage#this effect is used when the weapon is loaded but fired while overheated
empty rider damage#this effect is used when the weapon is not loaded
optional secondary firing rider damage#this effect is for later shots of a burst if set
Point offset^:[-1.1]#x-y offset - +x is right, +y is up
direction offset#Custom vectors must be set in distribution function above
position offsets#Custom vectors must be set in distribution function above
distribution angle:degrees#used by distribution function 'horizontal fan' above
deceleration time:seconds#the continuous idle time it would take for a barrel_error of 1.0 to return to its minimum value.
minimum error:degrees#projectile direction is randomly selected between this and max_error_angle below
error angle:degrees (max_error_angle)#current barrel_error is linearly interpolated between these to generate max_error_angle
damage error#the range of angles (in degrees) that a damaged weapon will skew fire
ai noise#how loud this weapon appears to the AI when firing
motion tracker noise#how far the weapon can be heard on the motion tracker when firing
heat generated per round:[0,1]#the amount of heat generated each time the barrel fires. Unlike the name suggests, this amount of heat is NOT applied per projectile created.
age generated per round:[0,1]#the amount the weapon ages each time the trigger is fired
CAMPAIGN age generated per round:[0,1]#the amount the weapon ages each time the trigger is fired
Tail sounds switch group#this is the switch group this weapon tail class will use
Tail sounds switch value#this is the name of the weapon for this weapon tail class
